notes.title: v1.0.006 UI Polish & Carrier’s Future
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43416049/b63080737c518f8e1682f154e29b8ced1d6b512d.png[/img]
[h1]Dear builders of Elven Cities,[/h1]

We’ve released a small but important update focused on UI fixes and quality-of-life improvements:

[h2]🛠 General:[/h2]
Fixed various issues in the main menu UI — it now looks cleaner and more stable.

[h2]🌿In-game UI:[/h2]
Resource descriptions no longer get cut off — text is now fully visible. The elf counter menu now correctly displays the number of citizens. The construction widget now shows full building names within the UI panels.

[h2]📚 Story and Logic:[/h2]
Some phrases in the campaign storyline have been revised for clarity. Fixed a bug that caused issues when switching between the number of buildings and elves on the map — display is now consistent.

[h2]🔮Coming Soon:[/h2]
Get ready — we're working on a major update that will introduce priority management for carriers! You’ll soon be able to control which resources your elves carry first.

Thank you for playing and helping us improve Elven City Simulator!
Your feedback on Steam means a lot to us 🍀

Full list of fixes goes like so:

✅ Buildings control menu fix
✅ Resources amount display fix
✅ Build menu descriptions display fix
✅ Build menu buttons display fix
✅ Elfs amount display fix
✅ Main menu UI items display fixes
✅ First mission eding text fix

notes.title: V1.0.005 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43416049/4a55135323e3527a4601c6614ab0a8a9aac04938.jpg[/img]

[h1]V1.0.005 Patch Notes[/h1]

🌿 [b]Fixes and Improvements  [/b]
We’ve been hard at work squashing bugs that hindered your cozy elven city-building experience. The interface is now more responsive, and some pesky issues affecting the economy and citizen movement have vanished into oblivion (if you know, you know).  

[b]Coming Soon: Revolutionary Worker Priority System!  [/b]
Get ready for one of the most user-friendly mechanics in city-building games — [b]dynamic elf employment allocation[/b]! You’ll be able to prioritize professions on the fly, directing workers between workshops, farms, and magical ateliers. More control, less chaos!  

✨ [b]Expanding the Game World [/b] 
We’re also hard at work expanding the in-game universe: new events, characters, and secrets of the ancient forest await discovery. Soon, you’ll uncover more about this world’s legends and shape its destiny - stay tune for mission 5!

Stay tuned — there’s plenty more magic on the way! 💫  

P.S. Thank you for your feedback and suggestions! Keep sharing your thoughts—it helps us make the game even better.  

Full list of fixes goes like so:

✅ Resolution selection drop-down
✅ Scroll bar now shows percentage
✅ Fixed wheat harvest widget call
✅ Bakery “Cancel/Produce” button works again
✅ Bunkhouse upgrade fixed in Mission 2
✅ Updated character portraits
✅ Fixed Mission 2 restart issue from main menu
✅ Qlipoths now hidden behind trees and buildings

notes.title: v1.0.004 The story continues
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43416049/085e17f43d98cd8129648ebde6a4ad4012abe054.png[/img]
[h1]Hello, elves![/h1]

While we were wracking our brains over code and fixing bugs, the update has already rolled out – and it's a big one!

Now in full color!🎨

We're continuing to make history: our world was once just text, but now the settlement is alive and thriving. We've added an intro – now the story and conflicts of the world you're about to play in are explained, narrated, and visually enriched.

So, here are some insights on our characters – meet your companions:

✨ The Chieftain – The first one the elves meet when they awaken. Cautious and wise.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43416049/1fd12c86e1c9fda213e3e6a6c90636b5b87e8d20.png[/img]


🌿 The Druid – A mysterious old sage. Gandalf from Chelyabinsk.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43416049/d2823536ab3ce13e1a8d8163fc3e46c453a8ae4b.png[/img]

🧪 Orc McScientist the 3rd – A rogue, a trickster, a swindler. Yes, the number is part of the name!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43416049/3d03b78c62bb12dba612145ea5a92b1aa4ed8d6d.png[/img]

🔨 Elf Worker – Kind, naive, and hardworking.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43416049/9df339ef5995244803d36c29703734732f83a2c3.png[/img]

👑 And, of course, other characters are waiting to be discovered!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43416049/5b15123738ec461411e93dfea93f931069779d0a.png[/img]


🐞 Bug fixes – the world is now a little better
Not just the game world, but who knows – once we release the game, maybe the real one will improve too! Most of our fixes are on the in-house engine and tools side, making them hard to notice for players. But as our team grows, here’s a proud list of what we did::

✅ Enabled clickCallbacks in button switches
✅ Batchable voxels support
✅ Fix colored text clamp
✅ Pipline for screen fade in/out
✅ Multi-threaded serialization
✅ Disable optimizations, fix transparent sprites animation


We're back to work, but in the meantime, hop into the game, check out the updates, and leave your feedback – we can’t wait to hear what you think! 🚀

notes.title: The Roadmap: A Major Update for the City-Building Game is in Development
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players and subscribers,[/h1]  

We are thrilled to announce that work on a major update for our city-building game has reached a new level! Our team has finalized the roadmap that will shape the future development of the project. We are meticulously refining every detail to make the game even more engaging and user-friendly for you.  

What can players expect in the upcoming updates? Svartalfs foraging berries from bushes, new aggressive objects on the map, a new production chain, a new resource—honey, a new mission, and, of course, fixes for the issues you’ve reported. We are confident that these changes will delight both new players and our loyal fans.  

Stay tuned for more news—very soon, we will share details about what exactly will be included in the next update. We are working hard for you and preparing plenty of exciting content!  

Thank you for staying with us. Your support inspires us to keep moving forward!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43416049/ee81dfc9ec05cc441759bc52dfc9a55fa9f334bb.png[/img]

The Elven City Simulator development team.

notes.title: Resolutions, bindings and turns
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, elves![/h1]

We’ve been reviewing your feedback and updating the game. Over the past week, we’ve added some features considered "must-haves" in modern games. These include support for a wider range of screen resolutions, from the Steam Deck’s 1280x800 to 4K.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43416049/558e4aae95e1a8ac3e05b6aa258271baec55e472.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43416049/829e58895e2da50346aa5f61afa634993b6a5334.png[/img]

And last but not least, you can now rotate buildings to face their entrances left or right. This gives you a bit more freedom to organize your Elven City just the way you like it!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43416049/9a6ed918e03c449e40c255771cc05266f06d94ff.png[/img]


Thank you to everyone who supports us. Below, you’ll find the full list of changes and fixes we’ve added.

[list]
[*] Configurable key bindings in options
[*] Screen resolution support: 1280x720, 1280x800, 1366x768, 3840x2160
[*] Buildings now can be turned left or right
[*] Fixed a crash on changing resolution on external monitor in fullscreen mode
[*] Fixed latern building when no stone available
[*] Bunkhouse and Mansion are now decrease max elfs count on dismantle
[*] Decreased font size in story log to fit all lines
[*] Outline added to Stone Quarry upgrade animation
[*] Dining room display fixed
[/list]

Don't lose yourself in the fog,
thundercatofdoom and CleDeSol

notes.title: Elven City Simulator v1.0.000 released
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Elves! [/h1]

First Release Version - v1.0.000 of Elven City Simulator is here!
We've worked hard on this cozy, slightly mystical, but overall charming city-building game. Thanks to everyone who supported us throughout these 1.5 years of development! It was quite a challenge, but we hope we've managed to deliver an enjoyable experience. Although this is a release version, we are not done with the game, and new updates will definitely be coming.

We are a small, truly independent team, driven by nothing but passion and the desire to make games. We started this as a hobby game engine project ended up becoming a full game (sic!). So, please excuse any potential bugs (and kindly report them, preferably through Discord). This version contains 3 out of 5 story levels and a free-play mode, so we definitely plan to deliver updates, including finishing the story and enhancing game mechanics, and possibly the combat system.

As for our in-house IndieGo engine – it's still powering this game, and we're continuing to develop it!
Dive deep into Elvish city-building, uncover the mysteries of the fog, and enjoy the fairy-tale story. Good luck!

Don't loose yourself in the fog,

notes.content:
[h1]Hey there, elves![/h1]

We're starting fresh this Monday with a new update! This time, we've decided to add a building grid display. It was quite challenging to pick a spot for your new house or berry hall, but not anymore. An emerald green highlight will guide you to the proper spots on the map.

notes.title: V 0.1.013 - THE CHECKBOX
notes.content:
[h1]Hello there, elves![/h1]

We are working on a full-scale story campaign. Mostly, our activities were in creating a special version of the game for our sound designer. But in the meantime, we couldn't miss that several people joined our Steam community recently, and we wanted to say thanks. To mark such an event, we decided to tackle a problem that bugged our demo from the very beginning - the default checkbox. Can you really tell the difference between on and off?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43416049/8b8c593715c8b8b52e0ec7ba6e943b9b9e0e4e40.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43416049/f3ebd124240322186aba7a1e51aab0bf2dcc5498.png[/img]
Probably yes, but it's not obvious. So, we worked hard day and night, developing and researching, and we came up with THE CHECKBOX. NOW GAZE UPON ITS ETERNAL BEAUTY AND REASONABLY CLEAR DISPLAY, MORTAL!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43416049/6769bf1b6255b5d8280298fa4adbe128baad2ac2.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43416049/5f1c56fd45aecfcfa57633b42e70241b9e42f4b9.png[/img]

We also added nice decals on top of all in-game objects windows:

notes.title: "Quality of Life" UI update is ready!
notes.content:
Hello Elfs!

[h1]The "Quality of Life" UI Update is now available for everyone![/h1]

You will love the new UI that will allow you to build structures easily.

With this new UI system, the information about numbers of elfs, buildings, enchanted trees and missions will be available at any time. So all the newly elements placed on the screen. We are tried to make good their positioning. 

We took a bit more time to fix bugs, but we are completely reworked system for issuing tasks to employees system - demo should goes better!

Also we added a city builder tutorial that include the following information:
[list]
[*]Introduction to the game mechanics
[*]Information about User interface
[*]Short help notes in Build menu about all available structures
[/list]
Now you can move around the map with WASD buttons and hide buildings and trees by pressing X button.

Thanks to everyone supporting us, giving feedback, reviewing the game, and sending us good vibes!

Make your journey into mist!

[h2]Full Changelog - v0.1.0 - "Quality of Life" UI Update[/h2]
[b]Major changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]New UI for every type - like main menu, pause menu, game elements
[*]New Elfs state. Now they can get tired and should rest in bunkhouses
[*]Wheat now stored in Great Tree (before - in wheat processing)
[*]New sounds for buttons and some game objects
[*]Mini tutorial
[*]Little stories about all the bushes and trees on the map
[*]New Elfs Logistic system
[/list]
[b]Bug fix:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fullscreen
[*]Hidden Great Tree position
[*]Game interactive objects are now highlighted correctly
[/list]
Somes more improvements here & there

We also keep developing our IndieGo Engine - game runs on it. Feel free to report any changes you experienced about the game performances. Next update should receive some quests, new buildings and worker animations, more work on sound design and musical accompaniment.

notes.title: Roadmap and features! Demo is planned to be updated in the several weeks!
notes.content:
[h1]Features guaranteed to be in the update[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Tutorial[/b]. We use mechanics from old German school strategy games like The Settlers, The Nations and Knights and Merchants. Not everyone remembers how to play them, and moreover, few people are familiar with this genre.
[*][b]Story beats[/b]. Gradual immersion in the essence of what is happening, more of an artistic text.
[*][b]Updated UI[/b]. We have a basic UI that we made for our engine. It has been completely redesigned, it has become much more convenient and more responsive.
[*][b]Low-effort quests[/b].
[*][b]New buildings[/b], including small ones - a workbench, a lantern, a loom.
[*][b]Worker animations for buildings[/b]
[*][b]Random events[/b] impacing your villagers life
[*]A completely [b]reworked system for issuing tasks to employees[/b].
[*]Great work on [b]sound design and musical accompaniment[/b].
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43416049/4baf1079e8b7a3d47a73ebc538143288266016fe.png[/img]
[h2]Whats next?[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Second location[/b] (Golden fields), expansion of their possessions
[*][b]New resources[/b]
[*][b]Trade[/b]
[*][b]New buildings[/b] and [b]tier 2 upgrade[/b] for the old ones
[*][b]New supply chains[/b]
[*][b]JRPG Battle System[/b]
[*][b]New events[/b]
[/list]
There's a [b]lot more to come![/b]

See you soon and don't loose yourself in the fog,
thundercatofdoom and CleDeSol
